title: [main] Implement item variant caching in calculate inventory
summary: The Calculate Inventory report now caches item variant information to reduce redundant database lookups when processing multiple records with the same variants.
key_points: Item variant existence and blocked state are cached in a dictionary during calculation
Reduces repeated NST data cache checks and SQL queries for the same variants
Improves performance in scenarios where many records share the same variants
Dictionary approach eliminates NST cache maintenance overhead
quote: Caches processed Item Variants in the dictionary: whether Item Variants exists and Blocked state.
